concepts.title: Two Missouri storm-claim myths

authority.note: Storm Damage & Insurance Claims is an approved service but has no page (Authority Fix Now B: create /services/storm-damage); the Drafter refuses it as a target, so this links to Roof Replacement.

strategy.eeat: Trust: correct, sourced public law (RSMo 407.725), not a claim about Lucas. Owens Corning Preferred Contractor (sourced). Does not use the storm-specialist claim (its only source is a directory listing).
strategy.market_signal: Timely: MO Attorney General charges against a contractor who took upfront payments from St. Louis tornado victims (May 2026); Missouri bars contractors from paying/rebating deductibles or negotiating claims. Format: myth vs fact.

concepts.why: Protective and local: it makes Lucas the roofer who tells you the rules, at the moment people are being warned about the opposite.

facebook.copy:
⚠️ Two things Missouri homeowners should know before signing with any roofer after a storm.

Myth: "We'll take care of your deductible."
Fact: Missouri law doesn't allow a roofing contractor to promise to pay or rebate any part of your insurance deductible.

Myth: "Let us handle your insurance company for you."
Fact: A contractor can't negotiate your insurance claim on your behalf in Missouri. That conversation is between you and your insurer.

If someone at your door offers either one, slow down and ask questions. And if you're considering a roof replacement after storm damage, we're a local call away. Lucas Construction is an Owens Corning Preferred Contractor in Wentzville.
